title: Synergy Baseball App: Single Game and Practice Views
description: Explore pitch-by-pitch Single Game view and the Practice and Multi-Practice views built from Synergy Team Logger data.

modules.title: Single Game View
modules.summary: Pick a league, season and team, then drill into one game through the line score, strike zone and at-bat views.
learning_objectives: Use the line score and strike zone
Switch between the four data views
modules.content:
## Getting started

Open Single Game from the **View** menu at the upper right. Select a **League, Season and Team**. Optionally enter an **Opponent**; if you skip it, all season games appear in a list.

## Using the report

- **Video setting** (top left): Player, Editor or Compare.
- **Find Game** menu: the arrow icon at far left lets you change filters or pick another game.
- **Line Score**: runs by inning. Click inning boxes (they turn light blue) to show those at-bats; the radio button at far right shows all at-bats for a team.
- **Strike Zone**: pitch locations for the selected at-bat, from the **pitcher's perspective** by default. Use the **Catcher's View** tab to switch.
- **Play** below the Line Score plays the full game.
- Toggle **Pickoff Attempts** with the radio button.
- Switch data views with the right-side icons: **At-Bat Summary** (default), **Pitch List**, **Pitch Detail**, **Sequential**.
- Expand the filters on the right to **View by Player** or **View by Inning**.
- The at-bat sequence (bottom right) lists at-bats from the innings you selected; use the arrows to scroll.

questions.question: From which perspective does the Strike Zone display by default?
questions.explanation: The default is the pitcher's perspective; Catcher's View is a tab.

questions.question: Which is the default data view in Single Game?
What happens when you click inning boxes in the Line Score?
options: Their at-bat data is shown and the boxes turn light blue
questions.explanation: Selected inning boxes turn light blue and show their at-bats.

modules.title: Practice View
modules.summary: Practice view surfaces Team Logger practice footage grouped by session type, visible only to your team.
learning_objectives: Name the four practice session types
Navigate a session and play clips
modules.content:
## What it is

Practice view sits at the top right between Reports and Single Game. It retrieves practice footage and data captured with the **Synergy Team Logger**. **Only members of your team** can see it.

Sessions are grouped into tables: **Sim Games, Batting Practice, Bullpen, Training/Workout**.

## Navigating

- **Search bar** by player or team; dropdown filters for League, Season, Team, Player; **Clear** to reset.
- Click column headers to sort.
- **Play icon** plays all clips for a session; **View Session** opens logged data. Use the left arrow to return to the Practice home screen.

## Session types

- **Sim Game**: works like a standard game in Single Game format (pitch and hit locations, results, video). Best for scrimmages.
- **Batting Practice**: pick a session, click **View Session**; use **Group** buttons and player names to filter. If only timestamps were logged, clips still play but data shows as "unknown", a quick way to split BP into clips.
- **Bullpen**: **Pitcher** buttons list a pitcher's pitches; selecting a pitch highlights the **intended** and **actual** location. The **Field** icon shows pitch location, type, velocity, delivery, execution and intended location. **Compare** and **Overlay** are available.
- **Training/Workout**: **video only**, no data. A repository staff can categorize, with a **Labels** button for players and labels.

questions.question: Who can see Practice view data?
questions.explanation: Practice data is visible only to your team.

questions.question: Which practice type is video-only with no attached data?
questions.explanation: Training/Workout sessions are a video repository.

questions.question: In a Bullpen session, what does selecting a pitch in the table highlight?
questions.explanation: It shows both the intended and actual location on the display.

modules.title: Multi-Practice View
modules.summary: Combine several practice sessions to track player trends over time, like Multigame does for games.
learning_objectives: Know which practice types can be aggregated
modules.content:
## Overview

Multi-Practice view combines and analyzes data from **several practice sessions at once** so you can track performance and development over time. It works like Multigame view does for games. Open it with the **Multi-Practice** icon at the top right.

## Practice types you can aggregate

Logged in Synergy Team Logger:

- **Sim Game**: performance and outcomes from simulated game scenarios.
- **Batting Practice**: hitter performance and contact quality.
- **Bullpen**: pitcher mechanics, pitch usage and execution.

(Training/Workout is video-only and has no data to aggregate.)

## Filters

- **Hitter(s)**: individual hitter trends.
- **Swing Result**: outcome of each swing, to spot patterns in contact, misses and balls in play.
- **Practice(s)**: pick the sessions to review together.
- **Practice Type**: limit to one type.
- **Pitch Zones**: **Pitch Execution** (how well pitches matched intended location) and **Intended Pitch Zone** (the planned target zone).

questions.question: Which practice types can Multi-Practice aggregate?
questions.explanation: Sim Game, Batting Practice and Bullpen are supported.

questions.question: What does the Pitch Execution filter measure?
options: How well pitches were executed relative to intended location
questions.explanation: Pitch Execution compares actual to intended location.

questions.question: Multi-Practice view is most similar to which view?
questions.explanation: It is designed to work like Multigame view, but for practices.
